name: Mission Control
description: Streams sanitised agent lifecycle events to https://api.menuboard.online/v1/agents for the live dashboard at https://menuboard.online/agents/.

agentId.description: Stable agent id used to register with Mission Control.

agentName.description: Display name. Falls back to the OpenClaw agent id when unset.

apiKey.description: Plaintext agent API key provisioned via the admin endpoint. Never sent in plain metadata.

heartbeatMs.description: How often to send a heartbeat when no other events are happening.

queueSize.description: Max in-memory event queue. Oldest are dropped when full.

disablePlugin.description: Set true to leave the plugin loaded but emit nothing (handy for tests).
